_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,152 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 215 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2017 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and omni-channel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'For purchases made on Lowes.com, customers may pick up their purchase in-store, have their purchase delivered from a store, or have their purchase parcel shipped.'. The stock trades at 18.1x FY19E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,152 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 215 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.03x; +13% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.18; conservative 2yr +37%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -35.3%/yr (worst year FY08-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.6%/yr (FY19 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.6%/yr (FY08-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2019-03-29) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.03x (63.5% downside to Bear $40 / +61.7% upside to Bull $177) | Adj composite 1.91 vs market 2.08: gap -0.18 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +13% above the EPP floor $97 (16x FY19E $6.05) | Conservative 2-yr case: +36.6% total (+18.3%/yr) | At 18.1x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $145 sits at or below the BASE case; comps +1.7% in Q4 FY18, forward sales +2% (FY19 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
